headline: Bessent Deploys Debt Buybacks in Sign of Concern Over Yield Rise
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a major expansion of the U.S. government's long-dated bond buyback program on August 19, doubling the maximum size of operations to at least $4 billion and raising the single-session cap for 10-to-30-year bonds to $400 million. The program runs September 9 to November 4 and could result in up to $128 billion in annual repurchases. The announcement sent 10-year yields down 5.7 basis points to 4.647% and 30-year yields down 9 basis points to 5.196%.

Single-session cap for 10–30yr bonds raised to $400M

headline: Bessent acts to break bond market fever, head off rising borrowing costs
